description.en: Obsessions and compulsions consuming more than one hour per day
description.hi: प्रतिदिन एक घंटे से अधिक समय लेने वाले द्वेष-विचार और बाध्यताएँ

mappingNote: ICD-11 OCD is 6B20, the parent of the 6B20-6B25 obsessive-compulsive-related family (body dysmorphic 6B21, olfactory reference 6B22, hypochondriasis 6B23, hoarding 6B24, body-focused repetitive behaviour 6B25) (index 5.1.2).
